interpretation: The DCPA-only diagnostic produced ROC-AUC = 0.877048. This demonstrates that DCPA is strongly predictive of the conflict label, but does not by itself prove deterministic label leakage. The CPA-only GAT is therefore treated as an ablation demonstrating the predictive contribution of CPA geometry.
methodological_status: CPA-inclusive configurations are treated as diagnostic ablations. The No-CPA configuration represents the observable-state-only formulation.
